deploy-bot: Deployment queued — concurrency gate triggered. service=runtime-api env=prod tag=v2.14.0 commit=abc1234 requested_by=@maria. Concurrency limit=2; active=2. Your request is queued at position 3. ETA ~15m. Reason: concurrent_deploy_limit. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1747654321`. To request priority bump add `manual-priority` on the release PR or ping release lead. Docs: https://go/release-process

maria: Ack. This is the token-leak hotfix — P1. Can we bump priority? @kevin please confirm impact if we wait.

kevin: If we can do a 10% canary it might avoid needing a full slot. Is repo set up for partial rollout?

samir: We're technically outside the change window but this is P1. I'm +1 for a manual override if release lead approves. Will prepare rollback steps.

leigh: Ops question: please hold if the active jobs include migrations. @deploy-bot which two deploys are holding slots?

deploy-bot: Active deploys: runtime-worker (started_at=1747654000) by alex; infra-migrations (started_at=1747654100) by ops-bot. Both count toward concurrency and are non-preemptible.

maria: Ok. I'll wait 10m and re-check. If still queued I'll ask for manual-priority.

kevin: If we need to free a slot fast, one option is to pin runtime-worker to previous tag for now. @alex any chance to pause/pin?

alex: Not possible — migration has long-running DB work. Can't pin mid-migration without risk.

deploy-bot: Manual priority bump requested by samir. Queue position updated to 2. Note: manual override requires release lead approval before execution.

leigh: I approve manual-priority for this release. @deploy-bot you have release-lead approval to proceed when a slot frees.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime-api v2.14.0 (abc1234) -> prod. started_at=1747654390. Mode=canary 10%. Triggered by: manual-priority override.
